wiki.title: Scott Hilton (politician)
wiki.extract: Scott Hilton is a real estate investment firm executive and politician representing the 48th District in the Georgia House of Representatives. He serves constituents in Peachtree Corners, Johns Creek, and Roswell. At the Capitol, Hilton is the vice chair of the House Education Committee where he has sponsored and passed legislation on education, social media protections for minors, and support for disabled Georgians. Hilton is also vice chair of the House Creative Arts and Entertainment Committee where he has passed legislation on film tax credits.
